description: This file defines a protocol 'MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices' and a class 'LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices' implementing this protocol. It provides functionalities for screen recording and location services, including managing permissions and retrieving current location data, tailored for macOS in an asynchronous context.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: An implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices that manages screen recording and location services including authorization and location updates.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Initiates screen recording with optional parameters such as screen index, duration, fps, audio inclusion, and output path. Returns the recording path and audio presence status.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization level for location services.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location with desired accuracy, maximum age, and timeout parameters asynchronously.
